title: Control-repository trust policy for qiven-workspace
law: ADR-0052 decision 4 and accepted architecture doc 01 section 2.3: an exact SHA proves identity, not authorization; authoritative bootstrap requires this independently held policy (held in qiven-context governance, outside the control repository it governs) to name the permitted control repository and admit exact control revisions.

Until this policy is owner-accepted (owner H2, governance class, non-delegable under long-running mode) AND admits an exact revision, every qiven-workspace revision is a labeled shadow/local input: it cannot publish, satisfy an authoritative gate, authorize a class cutover, or serve WR-7.

Admission advance: an owner-accepted decision (ADR or recorded owner adjudication in qiven-context) adds the exact control revision(s) to admitted_control_revisions; routine lock movement inside an already-admitted control-revision state does not require a new owner step (doc 02 section 7.7).
Revocation: owner decision; removing a revision or the whole policy returns the workspace to shadow-only and fails authoritative bootstrap with UntrustedControlRevision.
This policy never grants execution authority (ADR-0043 RuntimeHost remains the machine-local mutation path) and never overrides qiven-context canonical Git authority.

routine_advance_rule.decision: Owner turn-1 direction in v29 (bundled with the WR-3 admission per the v28 pending-decision block)
routine_advance_rule.rule: A control-main commit is a routine advance, auto-admitted without a new owner step, when its diff is limited to node advancement in workspace.lock.json (commit/tree fields and the recomputed generation) plus the declarations/ cache entries that advancement writes, and every advanced node commit is the corresponding canonical repository main HEAD with a passing shadow receipt. Anything else (bootstrap, manifest, census, schema, or any non-advance change) is NOT a routine advance and requires explicit admission.
routine_advance_rule.recording_duty: Every routine-advance admission is recorded (commit SHA, moved nodes, shadow receipt) in the executing session's checkpoint; admitted revisions are never deleted before WR-8.
